sdk_sources.proof: Native None timeout maps to u32MAX nanoseconds; browser clamp0 is not permission for synchronous waits.
Native fence client_wait_sync further clamps to i32MAX; TIMEOUT_EXPIRED/WAIT_FAILED ->false.
Maintain waits latest observed successful submission; unsatisfied fence with nonempty queue ->Timeout despite None API timeout.
Native pop removes correct thread-local top scope synchronously and returns ready(scope.error); poll returns actual mapped PollError, other errors follow fatal policy.
Guard !Send/!Sync; pop closes immediately; Drop pops without waiting.
PollError Debug/Error but not Clone; retain actual error rather than reconstructing it from text.

findings.source_scenario: Native GL submitted work remains unfinished past effective wait timeout. Device::poll returns actual PollError::Timeout, but every scoped site discards it. Ready pop may return None, so construction/view/record/conversion reports success and pipeline create may publish ObservedOk despite failed progress policy. If pop has a native error, only that cause remains and the poll failure is lost.
findings.connected_repair: One native owning ValidationScope handles wait-then-pop on both outcomes and returns Native vs Progress retaining actual poll and optional native. All18 root and5 peer sites must consume it under exact existing cfg/policy; preserve separate no-wait and real completion contracts.
findings.acceptance: One progress attempt, always pop once before returning; never turn Poll Err into Ok; preserve simultaneous poll/native errors; no unchecked publication and no borrowed/browser wait.

findings.source_scenario: The statement that blocking poll has no timeout contradicts native SDK GLES None timeout clamps and core Timeout result.
findings.connected_repair: Document timeout None as requested SDK policy with possible backend progress failure; retain latest-observed-submission semantics and no completion/global-health overclaim.
findings.acceptance: Current docs do not promise no timeout and identify typed progress behavior/borrowed/browser limits.

refined_contracts.status: refined proposal acceptable; implementation not reviewed
refined_contracts.contract: ValidationScope::new(&WgpuContext)->Option<Self> owns Arc<Device> and SDK guard; private fields establish pairing. finish(self) waits on that exact device, then pops even after Err. Borrowed false returns None; sites browser cfg skipped. Guard supplies !Send/!Sync and Drop closure; preserve SDK current-thread/LIFO requirements.

Native-only observation with successful operation unwraps to each old native owner and exact request/context/Display/source identity. Progress retains original non-Clone PollError and optional actual native error, with accessible typed fields; Arc wrapper only where existing Clone owners require it. No lossy text parsing/reconstruction.

refined_contracts.status: refined proposal acceptable; peer agreement required
refined_contracts.contract: ComputePassError::resolve_observation(operation:anyhowResult<T>,observed:ValidationScopeResult<()>): Ok/Ok ->value; Err/Ok ->same original operation error; Ok/Err ->old direct Native or new Progress mapping; Err/Err ->OperationAndObservation exposing original operation chain as source and typed secondary observation. Both needed for nested immediate Buffer allocate/write and peer Prepared.record; never skip scope closure on body failure.

refined_contracts.status: explicit root cache policy accepted; implementation required
refined_contracts.contract: Progress, including simultaneous native+poll, never enters permanent CachedPipeline::Observed. Remove older same-entry DeviceHandled value on Progress before returning Err; later calls retry. Preserve existing native-only rejection caching; compile state remains Prepared when compilation fails. ComputeSourceCache already publishes only successful closures.

A failed recording can leave commands in caller-owned encoder and FastPath.prepare can consume an arena slot before later error. New chunk publication itself remains after observation. Converter submission observation can fail after queue.submit already occurred. State these limits, do not promise rollback/no execution.

Shader/Pipeline/Pass From conversions unwrap Native into old Arc variants; whole texture view admission unwraps into old Box native variants. Never put a ValidationScopeError wrapper between ordinary anyhow and its native cause/downcast.
